---
title: "6. Bandits and Reinforcement Learning"
---

::: {.module-meta}
**Duration:** 14 weeks  
**Outcome:** Solve sequential decision problems from bandits through deep RL.
:::

## Core topics

Regret; UCB; Thompson sampling; contextual bandits; MDPs; dynamic programming; Q-learning; policy gradients; actor–critic; PPO; offline RL.

## Essential resources

- Lattimore, T., & Szepesvári, C. (2020). *Bandit Algorithms*. <https://tor-lattimore.com/downloads/book/book.pdf>
- Sutton, R. S., & Barto, A. G. (2018). *Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction* (2nd ed.). MIT Press.
- Stanford **CS234: Reinforcement Learning** — <https://web.stanford.edu/class/cs234/>
- Berkeley **CS285: Deep Reinforcement Learning** — <https://rail.eecs.berkeley.edu/deeprlcourse/>

## Milestone

Build a dynamic-pricing environment and compare a static benchmark, contextual bandit and RL policies.
